sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Purple & Emerald CZ Gold-Plated Anti-Tarnish Necklace
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Soft, dreamy, and effortlessly elegant — our Lavender & Emerald Vine Anti-Tarnish Necklace features light purple oval CZ stones paired with emerald green leaf accents on a gold-plated V-shaped vine chain. A delicate, feminine piece that brings a romantic softness to any outfit.
- 💛 Gold-plated with anti-tarnish coating
- 💜 Soft lavender purple oval CZ + emerald green leaf stones
- 🌿 V-shaped vine pendant — light and graceful
- 🔗 Delicate gold chain with secure clasp
- 🎁 Ideal for gifting, casual wear & festive occasions
Pairs beautifully with: Pastel pink, lilac, white, or mint ethnic and western outfits.
